app.name: Margin
app.privacyShort: On this device only. Not synced, not encrypted. Settings, backup and privacy
app.privacyMobile: Data stays on this device. Settings, backup and privacy
app.langNotSaved: Language choice could not be saved on this device; it applies until you close the tab.

templates.investigation: What does the source on page {page} say about "{title}", and what would you need to check to apply it?

interpretation.generated: Generated explanation · interpretation, not from the source
interpretation.none: No explanation. Optional: use Edit to restate this in your words.
interpretation.label: Explanation · interpretation (optional)
interpretation.placeholder: Restate the idea in your own words. Optional. Always treated as interpretation, never as source.

claims.warning: This adds a claim not in your source.
claims.heuristic: Word-level check against the excerpt only: highlighted words do not appear in the source, and causal or evaluative connectors are flagged when the source does not use them. It does not verify facts.
claims.clean: Every content word appears in the excerpt.

storage.unavailable: Local storage is unavailable in this browser. Changes will be lost when you close the tab.
storage.invalidSaved: Saved notebook data could not be read.
storage.invalidJson: Saved notebook data is not valid JSON.
storage.full: Browser storage is full. Your latest change was not saved. Export a backup and remove sources you no longer need.
storage.saveFailed: Your latest change could not be saved: {error}
storage.invalidBackupJson: This file is not valid JSON.
storage.invalidEnvelope: This file is not a Margin backup.
storage.invalidBackup: The backup does not match Margin's format: {error}
storage.orphanCitation: An item cites a source that is not in the backup: {title}
storage.invalidExcerpt: An excerpt does not match its source page: {title}
storage.corruptSuffix: Showing the demo notebook instead; your saved data has not been overwritten.

errors.title: Something went wrong
errors.body: This part of the app hit an error. The rest of the app is still running.
errors.notFoundBody: This view does not exist in Margin.

pdf.loadFailed: The PDF reader could not load in this browser. Try pasting the text instead.
pdf.password: This PDF is password-protected. Remove the password locally, then import again.
pdf.unreadable: This file could not be read as a PDF. It may be damaged or not actually a PDF.
pdf.noText_one: No selectable text was found in {count} page. This looks like a scanned or image-only PDF. Margin does not run OCR; paste the text instead.
pdf.noText_other: No selectable text was found in {count} pages. This looks like a scanned or image-only PDF. Margin does not run OCR; paste the text instead.

add.title: Import your PDF or notes
add.description: Your attached PDF is not bundled with this app. Import it here to keep extraction and study data on this device.
add.textPlaceholder: Paste notes or a passage. Use a form-feed character to separate pages if you need page numbers.
add.choose: Choose a PDF, TXT or MD file
add.chooseHint: Text PDFs only. Scanned images cannot be read without OCR.
add.privacy: Parsing runs in this browser tab. The text never leaves your device; it is stored unencrypted in this browser's local storage.
add.errChoose: Choose a TXT, MD or PDF file first.
add.errType: ".{ext}" files are not supported. Use PDF, TXT or MD.
add.errGeneric: Something went wrong while reading this source. Nothing was saved.
add.found_one: On-device extraction found {count} candidate. It is waiting in your Review inbox; nothing is in your library until you approve it.
add.found_other: On-device extraction found {count} candidates. They are waiting in your Review inbox; none are in your library until you approve them.
add.foundNone: On-device extraction found no usable sentences (they may be too short, or mostly numbers). The full text is still saved under Sources.

settings.title: Settings and where your notebook lives
settings.description: Plainly stated, so you can decide what to put here.
settings.languageHint: Applies to the interface only. Source excerpts always stay in their original language.
settings.demoBody: The demo source and its items are bundled with the app and labeled Demo. They are independently written study notes, not your document. Every demo candidate starts pending: nothing enters your library until you approve it.
settings.localBody: are stored only in this browser's local storage on this device. They are not synced, not backed up, and not encrypted.
settings.sharedBody: Anyone using this browser profile can open Margin and read everything in it.
settings.noAiBody: Candidates come from on-device extraction: exact sentences from your text. Investigation prompts and explanations are generated templates, labeled as interpretation. Nothing is sent anywhere, and source content is not checked against outside facts.
settings.clearBody: erases your notebook. Export a backup to keep a copy.
settings.rejected: Import rejected: {error} Your current notebook is unchanged.
settings.valid: Valid backup: {sources} sources, {items} items, {sessions} sessions. Importing replaces everything currently in this notebook.

sourcePage.description: Full page text as supplied. Margin does not verify it against anything else.
sourcePage.gone: This page is no longer in your notebook.

overview.headline2: to the words it came from.
overview.startBody: Your attached PDF is not bundled with this app. Import it here to keep extraction and study data on this device. Margin reads the text in this browser, proposes exact excerpts, and waits for you to approve each one.
overview.nothingApproved: Nothing approved yet. Approved notes appear here.
overview.stepReviewText: Approve, edit, merge or discard before anything enters the library.
overview.stepStudyNeeds: Needs at least one approved item.
overview.demoBody: This notebook opens with independently written demo notes on learning environments so every screen has something to show. All demo candidates start pending in your Review inbox; nothing is approved for you. Bundled demo excerpts are part of the app; anything you add stays in this browser only, unsynced and unencrypted, and readable by anyone sharing this device.

sources.title: The original words
sources.intro: Full text of every source, page by page. Your attached PDF is not bundled with this app; import it here and it stays on this device.
sources.emptyBody: Import a text PDF, a TXT or MD file, or paste notes. Margin extracts candidates on this device.
sources.demoNote: Demo study notes bundled with the app. Not your document.
sources.imported: Imported {date}. Stored only in this browser.
sources.importedFrom: Imported {date} from {file}. Stored only in this browser.
sources.unverified: Content is shown as supplied and is not verified externally.
sources.deleteBody: "{title}" and every item citing only this source will be removed from this device. Export a backup first if you might want it back.

goal.title: What are you studying this for?
goal.subject: Subject or goal
goal.subjectPlaceholder: e.g. prepare for the seminar on assessment design
goal.effect: Priorities reorder the Review inbox and study sessions for this source.
goal.demoDefault: Designing AI-supported learning environments for university teachers

priorities.howto_hint: Process and How-to items first; step guides first
priorities.exam_hint: Terms, concepts and items due first

review.title: Nothing enters the library unchecked
review.intro: Candidates from on-device extraction. Excerpts are exact sentences from the page; titles are short labels, and explanations are interpretation. Approve only what you would stand behind.
review.skipped_one: {count} skipped: both checks are required first
review.skipped_other: {count} skipped: both checks are required first
review.merged: Merged into one pending item with {count} excerpts
review.inboxClearBody: Nothing waiting for review. Import your PDF or paste notes to extract new candidates.
review.noDiscardedBody: Discarded candidates appear here and can be restored at any time.
review.checkAccurate: Is the explanation accurate to the source?
review.shortcuts: Keyboard: A approve · E edit · D discard

editor.title: Edit note
editor.description: Your words are editable. The source excerpt is locked so it always matches the original page.

library.title: What you have chosen to keep
library.count_one: {count} approved item. Every one cites the exact page it came from.
library.count_other: {count} approved items. Every one cites the exact page it came from.
library.emptyBody: Items appear here only after you approve them in the Review inbox. Nothing is added automatically. You can still search the full text of your sources below.
library.searchPlaceholder: Search notes, excerpts and full source text
library.noMatchesBody: Nothing approved matches "{q}". Search covers titles, explanations, tags and excerpts.
library.howtoNoneBody: Approve How-to or Process items to build a guide. Only source-supported steps appear.
library.howtoNote: Steps are your approved How-to and Process excerpts, ordered by page. The order is an arrangement by Margin, not a sequence stated by the source.
library.summaryNote: Extractive summaries: a collection of the exact excerpts you approved, in page order. No sentences are written by Margin.
library.summaryNone: No approved excerpts from this source yet.

study.title: Practise with your own approved notes
study.intro: Only approved items are used. Due items come first, then your study priorities. Every answer shows the excerpt and page it came from.
study.emptyBody: Approve at least one item in the Review inbox to unlock flashcards and focus sessions.
study.quizHint: Fill the blank, find the page

flash.recall: Recall what the source says, then rate your confidence before revealing.
flash.rateAfter: Compare with the excerpt, then rate.
flash.doneBody: {confident} rated confident. Ratings, confidence and next review dates are saved to each item.

quiz.notEnough: Not enough material for a quiz
quiz.notEnoughBody: Questions come only from your approved excerpts. Approve more items, ideally from different pages, to build cloze and source questions.
quiz.clozeInstruction: Fill the blank with the missing term from the source sentence.
quiz.sourceInstruction: Which source and page says this?
quiz.exactNote: The sentence is quoted exactly from your approved excerpt.

focus.logged: Session logged: {time} of actual focus time, {count} items read.
focus.durationNote: Only time actually spent (not paused) is logged. End early at any point.

dash.title: What you have actually practised
dash.intro: Every number here comes from your own answers, ratings and recorded sessions on this device. Nothing is estimated.
dash.emptyBody: Approve items, then study them. Ratings and sessions will appear here.
dash.dueBody: {due} of {total} approved items are due now.
dash.warningsBody: Times the detector flagged words or connectors not in the source.
dash.calibrationBody: Each row groups answers by the confidence you chose before answering. Well calibrated means higher confidence comes with more correct answers.
dash.calNone: No answers with confidence yet. Flashcards and quizzes record them.
